get.summary: Get a single context definition by id.
get.description: Returns the context whether it's active or archived — unlike the list endpoint, no state filter is applied here. Fails if no context with the given id exists in the caller's organization.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The context's id (e.g. "en"), as returned in the id field of the list/get response — not its internalId.

get.summary: List context definitions for the current organization.
get.description: Active contexts are returned by default; pass contextState=ARCHIVE to list archived ones instead. To look up contexts by known names rather than by state, use "List context definitions by names" (POST /context/list/by-names).

parameters.name: contextState
parameters.description: Filters by lifecycle state: ACTIVE (default) excludes archived contexts, ARCHIVE returns only archived ones.
